answer: Make each new agent enter through a bonded inlet: a 50-token deposit locked for 30 epochs and slashed if peers grade its work 0. A sybil nebula of 1,000 fake agents then ties up 50,000 tokens, and since copied answers score 0, roughly 90% gets burned, a ~45,000-token loss to buy at most 1,000 votes. Rewards cap per bond, so splitting one bond across identities earns nothing extra. The deposit is the jetty every newcomer must cross, priced above what a fake can earn.
